```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(lubridate)
library(broom)

# The handoff rule: this document reads ONLY what the SQL stage wrote to out/
# (plus the loader's reconciliation ledger). No raw file, no database
# connection, no hand-typed number anywhere in the prose.
monthly  <- read_csv("../out/monthly_by_product.csv")
daily    <- read_csv("../out/daily_products.csv")
weather  <- read_csv("../out/weather_daily.csv")
capacity <- read_csv("../out/capacity_by_year.csv")
coverage <- read_csv("../out/coverage.csv")
ledger   <- read_csv("../out/system_reconciliation.csv")

theme_board <- theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"))
dir.create("figs", showWarnings = FALSE)
```

*Reader note: this document is written for the General Manager and the board. Code is hidden throughout; every number in the prose is computed by the document from the pipeline's extracts at render time.*

## 1. What this system holds, and what it covers

```{r}
#| label: audit-counts
#| include: false
raw_total    <- sum(ledger$raw_rows, na.rm = TRUE)
loaded_total <- sum(ledger$loaded, na.rm = TRUE)
excl_total   <- sum(ledger$excluded_rows, na.rm = TRUE)
reportable   <- sum(coverage$reportable_trips)
cov26        <- coverage |> filter(year == 2026)
```

Across every source file the pipeline was presented with
**`r format(raw_total, big.mark = ",")` raw rows**;
**`r format(loaded_total, big.mark = ",")`** loaded,
**`r format(excl_total, big.mark = ",")`** excluded under named reasons, and the arithmetic closes file by file (ledger below).
**`r format(reportable, big.mark = ",")`** trips meet the reporting standard.
2026 coverage ends **`r format(cov26$last_day, "%B %d, %Y")`**.

## 3. The Integration Question

```{r}
#| label: join-safety
#| include: false
# Join-safety proof: the weather extract must be one row per date, or the
# join manufactures trips. The warehouse's PRIMARY KEY guarantees it; verify
# anyway, in the open, and show the row count is unchanged by the join.
wx_rows  <- nrow(weather)
wx_dates <- n_distinct(weather$date)
stopifnot(wx_rows == wx_dates)
```
